chunks: Aḥmad ibn Mihrān, from ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abū Ḥamzah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام descended with this verse upon Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله like this:

So those who wronged the family of Muḥammad in their right changed it for a word other than that which had been said to them; so We sent down upon those who wronged the family of Muḥammad in their right a torment from the heaven because they had been defiantly disobedient.

key_terms.آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله, whose rights are being emphasized
key_terms.الْآيَةِ: the verse being recited and explained
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibrāʾīl, the angel who brings revelation
key_terms.رِجْزًا: a punishment or torment sent from heaven
key_terms.يَفْسُقُونَ: they were acting in defiantly disobedient ways

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain Qur'an 2:59 in relation to the rights of Āl Muḥammad?
ai.summary: This report presents the verse in a form that explicitly links wrongdoing to the usurpation of the rights of Āl Muḥammad. Its significance lies in its use within Shia quranic commentary to emphasize the centrality of the Ahl al-Bayt and the gravity of injustice committed against them.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Abdul Azeem Bin Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Jibraeelas descended with this Verse unto Muhammadsaww, like this

- [2:59] But those who were unjust to the Progeny of Muhammadsaww of their rights changed it for a word other than that which had been Spoken to them, so We Sent upon those who were unjust to the Progeny of Muhammadsaww of their rights a Torment from the sky, because they transgressed’.
en.sarwar: 58. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from ‘Abd al-‘Azim ibn ‘Abdallah al-Hassani from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu Hamza from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Those who have done injustice (against the rights of the family of Muhammad (s.a.) will not receive forgiveness from Allah or guidance to any other path but that to Hell wherein they will remain forever. Then he said, “O people, the Messenger has come to you with the truth (Wilaya of Imam Ali (Leadership with Divine Authority). If you would have faith in it it would be better for you. If you would reject (Wilaya of Imam Ali (Leadership with Divine Authority) (know) that to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and in the earth.”
